Sign up for free here to receive this newsletter in your inbox every Saturday. You’ll also get our weekly newsletter with an exclusive introduction from our editor-in-chief. When you go to a new city, do you wonder where to wander? Some people try to find the best local coffee shop. Others opt for an authentic restaurant. I live by the book and seek out the best bookshop. Seeing what’s stocked (or not) and the line-up of author events can tell you a lot about a place.  I recently wrote about Shakespeare and Company, probably the world’s most famous bookshop, and asked readers to send in the name of their favourite bookshop. The response was overwhelming, and we have compiled a map of our readers’ top choices. Please share yours with us at plottwist@economist.com, and, if you’re a subscriber, consider signing up for Plot Twist, our weekly Culture newsletter, where we share recommendations and opinions you will not want to miss. Adrian's DeFi Insights 

Автор: Adrian Pape


Автор: Adrian Pape

Hey, it's Adrian! Two days, two punches out of Washington. Ouch. On Tuesday the Senate failed to even start debate on the CLARITY Act. On Wednesday the Fed raised rates for the first time since 2023. Bitcoin took both and is still at $76k as I write. For a week like this, this is a real sign of strength. Underneath the price, something did change though. The new money that carried Bitcoin more than 30% off the June low has stopped buying and the ETFs lost over $1 billion in seven sessions. Though the selling pressure is showing up in altcoins first. I still think the cycle bottom is in. The next few weeks just look more like a correction than a breakout. Let’s get into the broader picture and how to set up for the coming week: ️ ⚡ On today's Episode: 📈 Market Update – The Senate blocked the CLARITY Act 49 to 50 and the Fed hiked to 3.75%-4% the next day, with the 10-year near 5% and Brent above $100. Crypto regulation is now realistically a 2027 story. 🔊 Market Pulse – Bitcoin slipped below its $76k-$82k range and its Bull Score fell from 80 to 60 in a week. ETFs lost $1.05 billion in seven sessions and the Coinbase Premium turned negative, while altcoin deposits on Binance nearly quadrupled since July. 🐂 Alpha Insights – Bitcoin entered my first $75.7k–$74.3k buy tranche. I’m still building the position gradually, while keeping leverage controlled and a liquidation price around $30k because a deeper correction remains possible. Start with Washington, because both hits came from there this week. On Tuesday the Senate voted on whether to open debate on the CLARITY Act, the bill that would finally decide which agency regulates which crypto assets. It needed 60 votes and got 49. The crypto rules themselves were mostly agreed. It fell over ethics: Democrats wanted rules for officials holding crypto that would actually cover the president and his family. Zero Democrats voted yes. The motion to reconsider is still on the table, so technically it isn’t dead. Realistically, with the midterms in November the next window is after the election or 2027. Bitcoin dropped about 4% to $76k around the vote and over half a billion dollars in long positions got liquidated. → Nothing about the rules crypto works under today changed on Tuesday.
